title: A 42-metal Yb(III) nanowheel with NIR luminescent response to anions

synthesis.procedure: Yb(OAc)3 and HL were dissolved in ethanol at room temperature. An ethanolic triethylamine solution was added, and the mixture was stirred under reflux for 30 minutes. After cooling and filtration, diethyl ether was slowly diffused into the filtrate at room temperature. Pale-yellow crystals formed after one week; they were filtered, washed with ethanol, and dried in air for one week. The SI general procedures state that reactions used dry, oxygen-free dinitrogen and standard Schlenk techniques.

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 1 mL of a 1.0 mol/L solution in ethanol

reagents.name: ethanol
reagents.amount: 30 mL, plus ethanol in the triethylamine solution

synthesis.temperature: room temperature for dissolution, diffusion and crystallization; reflux during reaction
synthesis.time: 30 minutes under reflux; one week for crystallization; one week drying
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred reflux followed by diethyl-ether diffusion; SI general procedures specify standard Schlenk techniques
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool and filter; diffuse diethyl ether into the filtrate at room temperature; filter pale-yellow crystals, wash with ethanol (3 × 5 mL), and dry in air for one week.

properties.summary: Compound 1 exhibits ligand-centered visible emission and Yb(III) near-infrared emission. Its NIR luminescence responds to added anions: fluoride produces the strongest reported enhancement, while chromate quenches the emission.
